properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 8 at 10:05PM CDT until September 9 at 8:20PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:45 PM CDT Tuesday the stage was 26.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:45 PM CDT Tuesday was 26.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 18.8 feet Sunday
evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 26.2
feet on 03/19/1995.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Wednesday afternoon at 100 PM CDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL WEDNESDAY EVENING

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 1:29AM CDT until September 9 at 4:00PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Iowa...

Walnut Creek at Des Moines 63rd St affecting Polk County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Walnut Creek at Des Moines 63rd St, or from 1 1/3 miles
upstream of North Walnut Creek to the Raccoon River.

* WHEN...Until this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Walnut Hill Dr is closed. Lowland flooding
occurs along the east river bank downstream of 63rd St. At 14.0
feet, N Valley Dr is closed. Water affects Hoak Rd between Center
St as well as the levee affecting several businesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1:16 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 12.9 feet, and rising.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
this morning to a crest of 14.8 feet early this morning. It will
then fall below flood stage late this morning.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

River forecasts include observed precipitation plus forecast
precipitation over the next 24 hours.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT UNTIL THIS AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 9 at 3:02PM ChST until September 9 at 4:30PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
FFWGUM

The National Weather Service in Tiyan has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Guam...

* Until 430 PM ChST.

* At 302 PM ChST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.0 and 2.0 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, and streets as well as other poor drainage and
low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mangilao, Chalan Pago-Ordot, Barrigada, Yona, Talofofo,
Mongmong-Toto-Maite, Sinajana and Santa Rita.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
